## Multichannel surround encoding

- The “Keep surround audio” option now clears and disables itself when the selected source has no eligible surround track.
- When enabled, multichannel source audio is preserved at its original channel count. Its output codec is limited to AAC or passthrough; Opus is unavailable for multichannel output.
- AAC bitrate choices scale from stereo-equivalent settings by source channel count, with configured ranges covering 96–768 kbit/s for 6-channel sources and 128–1024 kbit/s for 8-channel sources.
- Retained surround streams have their output dispositions cleared. The generated stereo track remains separately configurable.
- The remote urgent-update policy now requires version 2.10.1.
